title: Ordinary tensor coherence of the localized inverse mate
statement: For the schemes, coefficients, g,V,l and ordinary inverse mate gamma defined in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction-data] and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-local-pullback-normalization], let F,G,H,K denote global pullback, Y restriction, X restriction and local pullback. For any ordinary module sheaves M,N on Y, gamma(M tensor N);H(muF(M,N));muH(FM,FN) equals K(muG(M,N));muK(GM,GN);tensor(gamma(M),gamma(N)), where the four mu are exactly the ordinaryTensor isomorphisms supplied by g and l. No complexes or derived tensor comparisons occur.

proof.text: Transpose the desired ordinary tensor square under the local module adjunction and precompose with the inverse Y-restriction tensor isomorphism. Tensor sheaf maps are determined by pure sections. The inverse restriction isomorphism restores the same pure tensor on the underlying global object, by pure_sections and its inverse law. Naturality of the local unit moves the Y restriction tensor comparison through it.

proof.text: On a pure tensor use the global and local pure_unit formulas. On the global route use the inverse-mate section identity and then restrictionX.pure_sections. On the local route use pure_map for gamma on the two factors and the same section identities. Both outputs are the pure tensor of the same restricted global units. Pure-section extensionality and adjunction injectivity conclude. Zero rings and zero modules require no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem localOrdinaryTensorSquare
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X)
    (g : Global f R_Y R_X c) (V : Y.ProEt)
    (l : Local f R_Y R_X c g V) (M N : Mod R_Y) :
    (localOrdinaryPullbackSquare l).app (((tensor R_Y).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u + 1}
          ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R_X)
          ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)).map (g.ordinaryTensor.iso M N).hom ≫
        (l.restrictionX.ordinaryTensor (g.operation.pullback.obj M)
          (g.operation.pullback.obj N)).hom =
      l.operation.pullback.map (l.restrictionY.ordinaryTensor M N).hom ≫
        (l.ordinaryTensor.iso (M.over V) (N.over V)).hom ≫
        (Functor.uncurry.obj (tensor (R_X.over ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V)))).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((localOrdinaryPullbackSquare l).app M)
            ((localOrdinaryPullbackSquare l).app N))
